ios.desc:
FreeWall is a simple and focused wallpaper app.

It is designed for people who enjoy discovering beautiful wallpapers without distractions.
No ads, no subscriptions, just wallpapers.

What you can do with FreeWall:
• Browse high quality wallpapers curated from trusted sources
• Set wallpapers instantly using Apple Shortcuts
• Explore hand picked wallpaper collections, updated regularly
• AI wallpaper generation turn your photos into pro wallpapers using the world's most cutting edge Nano Banana 2 model

FreeWall keeps things minimal.
There are no unnecessary features, no feeds to manage, and no clutter.
Just open the app, find a wallpaper you like, and set it.

Perfect for:
• iPhone lock screens
• Home screen backgrounds
• Minimal and clean setups

If you enjoy customizing your iPhone with beautiful wallpapers,
FreeWall is made for you.

show_hn.title: Show HN: FreeWall – A minimalist iOS wallpaper app using Shortcuts

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I built FreeWall after getting an iPhone Air recently.

I wanted to change wallpapers more often, but the process on iOS still feels surprisingly manual:
find an image, download it, go to Settings, set it, repeat.
So I really just wanted a small utility that does one thing well.

Apple doesn’t provide a public API to set wallpapers programmatically.
Instead of trying to work around that, I decided to lean into Shortcuts,
which is one of the most powerful (and underused) extension mechanisms on iOS.

FreeWall works by:

- Limited scope by design

– Curating high-quality images from free sources like Unsplash and Pexels (huge thanks to those communities)

– Letting users trigger a Shortcut to set the wallpaper in one tap

– Keeping the app free, with no ads, and no subscriptions

This won’t be useful for everyone, but it fits how I personally use my phone:
quick changes, minimal friction, and no noise.

I’d really appreciate feedback, especially from people who use Shortcuts or have thoughts on small, opinionated iOS utilities.

App Store link:
https://apps.apple.com/app/id6755912102
